# MediaSurface

**Class:** `UltraCanvasMediaSurface` · **Group:** [Base classes and other elements](../Groups/Base-And-Other-Elements.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasMediaViewer.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasMediaViewer.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasMediaViewer.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## Overview

Owns the currently displayed image plus its view geometry (zoom about the fit scale, pan, rotation in 90° steps, horizontal/vertical mirror) and the colour-processed pixmap. Re-rasterises the image at the displayed size each frame so it stays crisp at any zoom. Geometry (rotation / mirror / zoom / pan) is applied with the render-context transform, so it needs no re-processing; only the tone/colour adjustments go through PixelFX.

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
explicit UltraCanvasMediaSurface(const std::string& elemId = "MediaSurface");
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onNavigate` | `std::function<void(int)> onNavigate` | Called when the user navigates by click / arrow (delta -1 == previous, +1 == next) and when the view geometry changes (to refresh the info bar). |
| `onViewChanged` | `std::function<void()> onViewChanged` | _View changed_ |
| `onFilesDropped` | `std::function<void(const std::vector<std::string>&)> onFilesDropped` | Called when files are dropped onto the surface (so the host viewer can load them). Lets the drop work whether the event lands on the surface or bubbles up to the viewer. |
| `onDecodeFailed` | `std::function<void()> onDecodeFailed` | Called once per shown image when drawing finds its pixels do not decode (the header read, so it was shown; the reason is in the image's errorMessage). Runs after the frame, not inside Render, so the handler may relabel and re-lay out freely. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `MediaKind`

Chooses which child element renders it: images go through the image surface, documents through the PDF view, spreadsheets (ODS/CSV/TSV) through the spreadsheet element, 3D models (STL) through the OpenGL model viewer, text / source / markdown files through a read-only text area, e-books through the eBook viewer, and audio/video through their player elements. UCDoc marks an UltraCanvas Document container (*.ucd) and Vector a vector document no renderer here can rasterize (Xara, CorelDRAW, EPS/PostScript); both are displayed through the image surface (the preview bitmap the file carries) or the text area (a summary), so neither becomes the active view kind itself.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Image` |  |
| `Document` |  |
| `Sheet` |  |
| `Model` |  |
| `Text` |  |
| `Book` |  |
| `UCDoc` |  |
| `Vector` |  |
| `Video` |  |
| `Audio` |  |
| `Font` |  |

### enum `MediaTransition`

(Suffixed names avoid clashing with X11 macros such as None.)

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoTransition` | Instant swap |
| `CrossFade` | Both layers visible, sums to 1.0 |
| `FadeOutIn` | Old fades fully out, then new fades in |
| `SlideHorizontal` | Old slides left while new slides in from the right |
| `SlideVertical` | Old slides up while new slides in from the bottom |
| `ZoomFade` | New image zooms in from slightly enlarged while cross-fading |

### enum `TransparentImageBackground`

What is drawn directly behind the image, visible wherever the image has transparent pixels. Independent of the surrounding canvas colour.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `SolidColor` | flat preset colour (default white) |
| `Checkered` | light/dark checkerboard, as used by image editors |
| `Auto` | A flat colour chosen for each file from its own pixels: white, mid grey or dark grey, whichever leaves the most of the artwork clearly visible (UltraCanvasMediaViewer::ContrastingBackdropFor). The media viewer's default; a bare surface shows its SetAutoBackdropColor(). |

### struct `MediaAdjustments`

Applied through PixelFX to produce the displayed (and saved) pixels. Identity values leave the source untouched (and skip processing entirely).

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `gamma` | `double gamma = 1.0` | 1.0 = no change (PixelFX::Colour::Gamma) |
| `brightness` | `double brightness = 1.0` | multiplicative, 1.0 = no change |
| `red` | `double red = 1.0` | per-channel multipliers, 1.0 = no change |
| `green` | `double green = 1.0` |  |
| `blue` | `double blue = 1.0` |  |
| `sharpen` | `double sharpen = 0.0` | libvips sharpen sigma, 0 = off |
| `autoOptimize` | `bool autoOptimize = false` | histogram equalisation |
| `curves` | `ToneCurveSet curves` | Tone curves (the Curves dialog): master plus per-channel mappings, applied as a lookup table before the other colour work. This is what reaches highlights, midtones and shadows separately — the sliders move the whole tone range at once. |

Methods: `IsIdentity`

### struct `MediaViewerTools`

The view / edit groups of the toolbar that mean something for the file on show. The viewer offers only these, so a video, a PDF or a 3D model is not given colour sliders it cannot apply. Details (in the info bar) is always available. bitmap image zoom, transform, colour, save SVG / vector drawing zoom, transform, save - on the image surface; the vector view zooms and saves. Save writes the drawing in any vector or bitmap type, or, turned or mirrored here, the picture *.ucd preview zoom (it is a picture of a document, not an image) PDF, e-book zoom audio save (in any audio type this build encodes) video save (in any type FileLoader's ConvertVideoFile writes - none unless a converter is registered, VideoFX's: VideoFX_RegisterWithFileLoader) everything else nothing: text, spreadsheet, font and 3D model views bring their own controls

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `zoom` | `bool zoom = false` | zoom out / zoom level / zoom in / fit |
| `transform` | `bool transform = false` | rotate left / right, mirror horizontally / vertically |
| `colour` | `bool colour = false` | adjustments panel and Curves (with its histogram) |
| `save` | `bool save = false` | Save as... (a picture with its edits, a drawing, a recording, a video) |
| `unlock` | `bool unlock = false` | Unlock... (a password-protected file not unlocked yet) |

### enum `MediaUnlockResult`

What UltraCanvasMediaViewer::UnlockWithPassword made of a password.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Unlocked` | the file is shown whole |
| `WrongPassword` | not its password (or none was typed): still locked |
| `Failed` | the password was right, or could not be checked, but |
| `NotLocked` | the file would not open (damaged, no libsodium ...) the shown file is not a locked one |

### enum `VideoPreviewMode`

How the viewer behaves when a video file becomes the shown item.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Autoplay` | start full playback with sound (default) |
| `PreviewClip` | play the first few seconds muted, then pause |
| `Still` | (the UltraCanvasAlbum hover-preview style) show the prerolled first frame, paused |
